name: Recorder
description: Record a sample from the mics, the line-in or the pads, and trim it to a loop
changelog: 0.2.0: SYNC -- REC plays the open song from bar FROM and the take lines up with it (frame 0 on that bar, the codecs' delay taken off), the time as bar.beat; ARRANGE puts the marked loop on a track of the song, a synced take where it was sung; requires core 1.26
